name: Kickstand Step-Together Clean
description: A dead clean that starts in a kickstand stance and finishes with the feet together. Set up exactly like a kickstand row — working-arm-side foot staggered back on its toe, hinged over the front leg, bell on the floor. Drive the front hip to clean the bell into the rack, and as it lands, step the back foot up to meet the front so you finish standing tall, feet together, bell racked. To reset, step the back foot out again and return the bell to the floor for the next dead-stop rep. The step-together turns a plain clean into a balance and timing drill: the foot has to arrive as the bell does, and the front leg does the pulling. Keep the elbow tight and let the bell land in the corner of the hand, not across the palm.
